name: swf
description: Amazon Simple Workflow Service The Amazon Simple Workflow Service (Amazon SWF) makes it easy to build applications that use Amazon's cloud to coordinate work across distributed components.

subcommands.name: count-closed-workflow-executions
subcommands.description: Returns the number of closed workflow executions within the given domain that meet the specified filtering criteria.

subcommands.name: count-open-workflow-executions
subcommands.description: Returns the number of open workflow executions within the given domain that meet the specified filtering criteria.

subcommands.name: count-pending-activity-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns the estimated number of activity tasks in the specified task list.

subcommands.name: count-pending-decision-tasks
subcommands.description: Returns the estimated number of decision tasks in the specified task list.

subcommands.name: delete-activity-type
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified activity type.

subcommands.name: delete-workflow-type
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified workflow type.

subcommands.name: deprecate-activity-type
subcommands.description: Deprecates the specified activity type.

subcommands.name: deprecate-domain
subcommands.description: Deprecates the specified domain.

subcommands.name: deprecate-workflow-type
subcommands.description: Deprecates the specified workflow type.

subcommands.name: describe-activity-type
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified activity type.

subcommands.name: describe-domain
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified domain, including description and status.

subcommands.name: describe-workflow-execution
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified workflow execution including its type and some statistics.

subcommands.name: describe-workflow-type
subcommands.description: Returns information about the specified workflow type.

subcommands.name: get-workflow-execution-history
subcommands.description: Returns the history of the specified workflow execution.

subcommands.name: list-activity-types
subcommands.description: Returns information about all activities registered in the specified domain that match the specified name and registration status.

subcommands.name: list-closed-workflow-executions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of closed workflow executions in the specified domain that meet the filtering criteria.

subcommands.name: list-domains
subcommands.description: Returns the list of domains registered in the account.

subcommands.name: list-open-workflow-executions
subcommands.description: Returns a list of open workflow executions in the specified domain that meet the filtering criteria.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: List tags for a given domain.

subcommands.name: list-workflow-types
subcommands.description: Returns information about workflow types in the specified domain.

subcommands.name: poll-for-activity-task
subcommands.description: Used by workers to get an ActivityTask from the specified activity taskList.

subcommands.name: poll-for-decision-task
subcommands.description: Used by deciders to get a DecisionTask from the specified decision taskList.

subcommands.name: record-activity-task-heartbeat
subcommands.description: Used by activity workers to report to the service that the ActivityTask represented by the specified taskToken is still making progress.

subcommands.name: register-activity-type
subcommands.description: Registers a new activity type along with its configuration settings in the specified domain.

subcommands.name: register-domain
subcommands.description: Registers a new domain.

subcommands.name: register-workflow-type
subcommands.description: Registers a new workflow type and its configuration settings in the specified domain.

subcommands.name: request-cancel-workflow-execution
subcommands.description: Records a WorkflowExecutionCancelRequested event in the currently running workflow execution identified by the given domain, workflowId, and runId.

subcommands.name: respond-activity-task-canceled
subcommands.description: Used by workers to tell the service that the ActivityTask identified by the taskToken was successfully canceled.

subcommands.name: respond-activity-task-completed
subcommands.description: Used by workers to tell the service that the ActivityTask identified by the taskToken completed successfully with a result (if provided).

subcommands.name: respond-activity-task-failed
subcommands.description: Used by workers to tell the service that the ActivityTask identified by the taskToken has failed with reason (if specified).

subcommands.name: respond-decision-task-completed
subcommands.description: Used by deciders to tell the service that the DecisionTask identified by the taskToken has successfully completed.

subcommands.name: signal-workflow-execution
subcommands.description: Records a WorkflowExecutionSignaled event in the workflow execution history and creates a decision task for the workflow execution identified by the given domain, workflowId and runId.

subcommands.name: start-workflow-execution
subcommands.description: Starts an execution of the workflow type in the specified domain using the provided workflowId and input data.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Add a tag to a Amazon SWF domain.

subcommands.name: terminate-workflow-execution
subcommands.description: Records a WorkflowExecutionTerminated event and forces closure of the workflow execution identified by the given domain, runId, and workflowId.

subcommands.name: undeprecate-activity-type
subcommands.description: Undeprecates a previously deprecated activity type.

subcommands.name: undeprecate-domain
subcommands.description: Undeprecates a previously deprecated domain.

subcommands.name: undeprecate-workflow-type
subcommands.description: Undeprecates a previously deprecated workflow type.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Remove a tag from a Amazon SWF domain.
